items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Paul Whiteman played there one time.

ctx.x: What did the musicians in the band wear?

Well we had little Eton jackets. We had Eton jackets. We had a lot of fun. We worked at a place called 'Solomon's' dance hall. It was on Grande Street out there. A big dance hall. Where all the sailors used to go. And we did a good job. Paul Whiteman played there one time.
Oh, at the same place then?
